blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—College of St. Benilde finished the first half of the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament with an impressive record, and coach Paolo Layug knows just why his Blazers are doing very well. Following the squad’s 82-77 win over Mapua at Philsports Arena on Friday, the Blazers improved to a 3-1 card in Group A, just behind undefeated Jose Rizal University. And Layug points a finger at one very important team aspect. “Every day, we have new players stepping in and stepping up,” Layug said. “For (the next game), we don’t know who it’s going to be.
